name: remote-resume
description: /rresume lists, searches and resumes Claude Code sessions from the claude.ai web or mobile app, where /resume is unavailable. Brings back archived Remote Control chats and moves terminal sessions into Remote Control with their history, model, effort, permission mode and working directory.

auto_archive.title: Archive throwaway chats
auto_archive.description: After /rresume resumes a session, archive the chat you typed it in when that chat holds nothing but /rresume commands and at most one other message.
